desc: Parse input: read N, K and array A from stdin.
Decide side: compute total_xor = XOR of all elements; if K > N - K, set K = N - K and use complement mode (answer candidate = total_xor XOR subset_xor).
Implement iterative DFS over combinations (index stack) that maintains running XOR, enumerating all C(N,K) subsets with O(1) update per node.
Track maximum of (subset_xor) or (total_xor XOR subset_xor) depending on mode.
Verify complexity: C(N,K) ≤ 10^6 nodes visited, each O(1), well within limits; test on samples mentally (e.g., N=4,K=2 → 7).
Write final Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin) and print answer.
